description: Read a Tail 2's full live status block (one WebSocket push): power, recording, portrait rotation, AI mode + tracking settings, zoom ratio, roll bias, focus modes, NDI/RTSP/SRT/RTMP enablement, SD card, preset list with poses (degrees + zoom ratio), and per-subsystem health (gimbal/AI/battery/lens/ToF). NOTE: no live yaw/pitch — the Tail 2 reports pose only via saved presets, so gimbal moves are open-loop (same limitation as the Tiny 2 on Linux).
name: obsbot_tail2_status
